document: Approved Document K: Protection from falling, collision and impact (England)
quote: Have level treads on steps, ensuring that the rise and going of each step are consistent throughout a flight of steps
value: rise and going consistent in a flight; level treads

document: Approved Document K: Protection from falling, collision and impact (England)
quote: If the soffit beneath a stair is less than 2m above floor level, protect the area beneath a stair
value: soffit <2 m above floor: guard/barrier below stair

document: Approved Document K: Protection from falling, collision and impact (England)
quote: Steps may have open risers if they comply with both of the following guidance. a. Overlap treads by a minimum of 16mm. b. Construct the steps so that a 100mm diameter sphere cannot pass through the open risers.
value: open risers in dwellings: tread overlap >=16 mm and 100 mm sphere cannot pass

document: Approved Document K: Protection from falling, collision and impact (England)
quote: On the access between levels, provide the minimum headroom shown in Diagram 1.3.
value: minimum headroom 2 m on the pitch line/landing (Diagram 1.3 reads 'At least 2m')

document: Approved Document K: Protection from falling, collision and impact (England)
quote: ensure that stairs within the entrance storey of a dwelling have flights with a minimum stair width of 900mm.
value: 900 mm stair width, exceptional (severely sloping plot) entrance-storey stairs; ADK sets no other dwelling stair width

document: Approved Document K: Protection from falling, collision and impact (England)
quote: If stairs have more than 36 risers in consecutive flights, make a minimum of one change of direction between flights
value: more than 36 consecutive risers: change of direction >=30 deg

document: Approved Document K: Protection from falling, collision and impact (England)
quote: At the top and bottom of every flight, provide landings the width and length at least as great as the smallest width of the flight
value: landing width and length >= flight width

document: Approved Document K: Protection from falling, collision and impact (England)
quote: Position the top of the handrail 900mm to 1000mm from the pitch line or floor.
value: handrail top 900-1000 mm from pitch line/floor; both sides if stair >=1000 mm wide
